Messages.Author: BenPeal
Messages.Body:
Vampire: Elder Kindred Network Newsletter 18 January 2015

Of Interest to Scholars and Slanderers:

Hi, everyone!

Ralf "Extrala" Lammert is taking your votes for Deck of the Year on VTES One!

vtesone.wordpress.com/2015/01/16/poll-deck-of-the-year-2014/

Mike Nudd wrote an article for his blog called "Five Things You Should Know About VTES":

gameaholicblog.wordpress.com/2015/01/15/five-things-you-should-know-about-vtes/

Design Team News:

Gábor Németh submitted one of two pieces he's working on for the Storyline reward cards. Playtesting for them remains on schedule, and we'll have those released the weekend of February 7.

Our production schedule right now looks like Storyline reward cards in Februrary, cards for the summer 2015 storyline, Anarchs set in fall 2015, and a Bloodlines set in fall 2016.

Rules Team News:

Be sure to download the latest version of The Archon! Version v1.5c is available here:

vekn.net/images/stories/downloads/thearchon1.5c.zip

Major Events:

There will be a weekend of V:TES at TempleCon in Warwick, Rhode Island, USA, from February 5 to February 8. Events include a Standard Constructed tournament, a Continental Qualifier, a draft tournament, a lot of open play, and a convention full of gaming, music, vendors, performers, and much more! Check out www.templecon.org for more info.

Budapest, Hungary will be hosting the V:TES Hungarian Grand Prix from March 20 to March 22 at the Danubius Hotel Flamenco. Events include a Nations Cup tournament, a draft tournament, a Continental Qualifier, and a Standard Constructed "Grand Prix" tournament. The winner of the "Grand Prix" tournament will have their picture used in the next V:EKN expansion. Check out www.vteshungariangrandprix.hu/ for more information and to preregister.

Artist News:

Christopher Shy's new graphic novel, "I Sleep In Stone", is available now!

www.amazon.com/I-Sleep-Stone-Christopher-Shy/dp/1499770898/ref=sr_1_7?ie=UTF8&qid=1418882865&sr=8-7&keywords=I+Sleep+in+stone
